subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this custom yielding glob walker and bootstrap-only handler scheduling as the bounded fix for bootstrap-context event-loop stalls?
rationale: The branch has strong focused proof and no actionable correctness finding, but it intentionally changes compatibility-sensitive prompt construction and session scheduling, which automation cannot approve on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Land After Exact-Head Checks
options.body: Accept the bounded compatibility tradeoff and merge once required checks pass on the exact current head.

options.title: Require Connected Runtime Proof
options.body: Ask for a current-head embedded run with active channel or WebSocket traffic before accepting the scheduling change.

options.title: Defer To Broader Architecture
options.body: Pause or close if maintainers want worker isolation, priority scheduling, or caching instead of this focused mitigation.

recommendation.title: Land After Exact-Head Checks
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded compatibility tradeoff and merge once required checks pass on the exact current head.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest traced history spans the hook registry, bootstrap hooks, and guarded workspace reads that define this decision.
